card.name: "the" in "in the judgment of the physician"
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "the" right after "in" in the stock phrase "only if, in the judgment of the physician". It also fires weakly on a few other words that follow a drug name or a quantity word.

modes.label: Judgment-of-physician phrase
modes.description: "the" after "in" in conditional clauses about using a drug only when the physician judges the benefit worthwhile.
modes.example: this drug should be used during pregnancy only if, in<< the>> judgment of the physician, the potential benefit

modes.description: A hyphen-treated or "in" directly after a brand drug name in trial results.

modes.label: Other scattered cases
modes.description: A modifier or word start after an article or adjective in ordinary prose.
modes.example: the real numbers extended by the addition of a<< single>> signless infinity.
